written_before: any location-phase or priority-2/3/4 run (only priority-1 wide/control 1k runs had been launched, 11:41)

clarifications.what: stress case (mobilenet_v3_large-int6) and the 1k extension rules
clarifications.rule: The extension rules are not applied to the stress case: its reduced uniform grid (plan.stress_widths) is not a contiguous bracket, so the rules have no complete bracket to test. Its derived widths are reported as bounds over the measured widths only.

clarifications.what: launch order inside the location phase (runner tools/run/accumulator_sweep_mn_run.py)
clarifications.rule: Location runs rank after every priority-1 run and before priority 2. Within a case: the exponent-sensitivity runs first, then the next uniform rung (one new rung per case per pass, descending), then the next per-node d (one at a time per case). Cases in protocol order. No effect on which runs are made.

The step-1 smoke run (wide 0-64, before the protocol) is not counted. Priority 3/4 runs are launched only while (engine-ledger wall_seconds of this lane's predict calls since the protocol) + (35 s + 0.30 s per image for each running job) + the new run's estimate is below 14 h.
